description: Fixture corpus for the version 1 review domain: the audit events of docs/EVENTS.md section 7 that carry the review, finding, annotation and artefact records of docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md sections 14 to 20. Valid cases must decode and re-encode to the byte string recorded in canonical.json; invalid cases must be refused with the recorded reason. Several invalid cases exist only to hold the annotation coordinate contract: geometry outside 0 to 1 is a coordinate-frame mistake, and it is refused here rather than clamped, because a clamped coordinate produces a plausible-looking overlay in the wrong place.

valid.name: review-created
valid.note: The bugs-on-homepage review of docs/UX_FLOWS.md section 10, carrying the captured branch, commit, workspace and source browser session that make it reproducible after the session has gone (ADR-0004).

valid.name: review-named
valid.note: A rename. The previous slug is recorded because a slug is a mutable alias and never an identity (docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 3).

valid.name: review-status-changed
valid.note: DRAFT to READY by a human, with the version the record now holds so a consumer can tell a stale read from a fresh one.

valid.name: finding-created
valid.note: A human-authored finding with the whole docs/UX_FLOWS.md section 9 captured-context list: URL, viewport with device pixel ratio, scroll position, commit, screenshot artefact and element context.

valid.name: finding-annotated-rectangle
valid.note: The exact geometry shape of docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 16, normalised to the artefact content rectangle and referencing the original artefact rather than being drawn into it (ADR-0006).

valid.name: finding-annotated-arrow
valid.note: An arrow pointing up and to the right. Tail and head are separate normalised points rather than a signed delta, so no member ever has to leave the 0 to 1 range.

valid.name: finding-annotated-marker-at-bounds
valid.note: A numbered marker at exactly 0 and exactly 1. The range is inclusive, so the corners of an artefact are addressable; revision 3 shows that an edited annotation keeps its history.

valid.name: finding-status-changed-by-agent
valid.note: The furthest an agent may move a human-authored finding: AWAITING_HUMAN_REVIEW. The payload repeats the finding's source so the authority rule that permitted the transition is legible in the audit trail.

valid.name: artefact-upload-started
valid.note: An intent. Size and digest are declared values and are named as such, because nothing may treat them as verified until the server recomputes them.

valid.name: artefact-upload-completed
valid.note: Verification succeeded. The storage key is content-addressed and carries no user-entered name (ADR-0012), and the content rectangle records the frame annotation geometry is normalised against.

valid.name: artefact-upload-failed
valid.note: A digest mismatch. The artefact stays unavailable, so a finding that referenced it would remain visibly without evidence.

valid.name: artefact-access-granted
valid.note: Reading evidence is an audited access (docs/SECURITY.md section 16). The grant names one artefact, one subject and an expiry two minutes out (ADR-0019).

valid.name: screenshot-captured
valid.note: A verified screenshot at the 390x844 preset with a device pixel ratio of 2: the content rectangle is 780x1688 device pixels, which is exactly why geometry is not normalised against the viewport.

invalid.name: annotation-geometry-out-of-range
invalid.note: width 1.38 is outside the artefact content rectangle. Refused, not clamped: clamping would store a mark that renders somewhere plausible and wrong.

invalid.name: annotation-geometry-negative
invalid.note: A negative coordinate. The lower bound is enforced for the same reason as the upper one.

invalid.name: annotation-geometry-in-css-pixels
invalid.note: The most likely real mistake: geometry sent in CSS pixels instead of normalised units. The bound catches it at the boundary rather than at render time.

invalid.name: event-without-actor
invalid.note: docs/EVENTS.md section 5 requires the actor type to be explicit. An event that cannot say who acted is not an audit record.

invalid.name: unknown-message-type
invalid.note: Unknown types are rejected, never ignored. Events are append-only (section 4), so review.deleted does not exist.

invalid.name: unsupported-schema-version
invalid.note: A future envelope version is refused rather than best-effort parsed.

invalid.name: review-slug-not-a-slug
invalid.note: A slug is the value an agent is given on a command line. Spaces and capitals are refused at the source rather than normalised silently into something the human did not type.

invalid.name: finding-without-captured-context
invalid.note: Scroll position and screenshot are absent. docs/UX_FLOWS.md section 9 makes both required: a finding without them cannot be reproduced later, so it is refused rather than stored incomplete.

invalid.name: correlation-with-unknown-property
invalid.note: Correlation carries identifiers only. An authorisation header riding along inside it is exactly what docs/EVENTS.md section 8 and docs/SECURITY.md section 18 forbid, and additionalProperties: false is what stops it.

invalid.name: annotation-unknown-type
invalid.note: freehand is named in docs/DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 16 and is deliberately not implemented in Stage 0. It is refused rather than stored as geometry no renderer understands.
